t_snd_a
The same soundtrack as Flash ADPCM, which is what real content of this era uses. Four bits a sample, so a quarter of the bytes and all of the decode.

Listen for: exactly what t_snd sounds like, a little grainier. Anything else - noise, a rising hiss, the drone turning to buzz - is the decoder or the per-block seek, not the ring.

Stage 320 x 240, drawn at 1:1, 12fps, a four second loop.
